meta.title: NHT — New Horizons Team | Creator Management
meta.description: We build creator businesses. NHT is the elite management firm for OnlyFans, Fansly, and ManyVids creators worldwide.

hero.title: We build creator businesses.
hero.description: NHT manages strategy, operations, and growth for creators on OnlyFans, Fansly, and ManyVids. You create. We build the business around it.

services.label: Services
services.title: Management, engineered.
services.description: Six disciplines. One integrated team. Everything required to run a creator business at the highest level.

accountManagement.title: Account Management
accountManagement.description: Your platforms run without you in the inbox. Pricing, scheduling, profile optimization — managed daily by a dedicated team lead.

contentStrategy.title: Content Strategy
contentStrategy.description: Every post has intent. Calendars built from performance data, trend signals, and audience behavior — not guesswork.

fanEngagement.title: Fan Engagement
fanEngagement.description: Messages that convert. Retention sequences, personalized outreach, and conversation management that keeps subscribers paying.

revenueArchitecture.title: Revenue Architecture
revenueArchitecture.description: PPV funnels, tip structures, bundle logic. We engineer how money moves through your account — and optimize it continuously.

brandPositioning.title: Brand Positioning
brandPositioning.description: How you're perceived determines what you earn. Visual direction, social presence, and cross-platform identity — handled with precision.

globalOperations.title: Global Operations
globalOperations.description: Teams across time zones. Your accounts never sleep, never miss a sale, never leave a high-value fan waiting.

results.label: Results
results.title: Proof, not promises.
results.description: The numbers behind NHT. Measured, reported, and available to every partner.

creators.footnote: Under NHT management for 6+ months. Full-stack account optimization and revenue architecture.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Straight answers.
faq.description: What creators ask before partnering with NHT.

platforms.question: What platforms does NHT manage?
platforms.answer: OnlyFans, Fansly, and ManyVids are our core platforms. We also coordinate traffic from Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, and TikTok. As new monetization platforms emerge, we expand with them.

fees.question: How does NHT structure fees?
fees.answer: Performance-based. We earn when you earn. After a private consultation, you receive a transparent proposal aligned to your current revenue and trajectory. No retainers. No hidden charges.

control.question: Do I retain creative control?
control.answer: Completely. You own your content, your brand, your decisions. NHT handles operations, strategy, and fan communication. Nothing publishes without your approval.

timeline.question: How fast do results appear?
timeline.answer: Operational relief is immediate — we take over within days of onboarding. Revenue impact typically surfaces in 30–60 days. Compounding growth follows in months two through six.

confidentiality.question: How is confidentiality handled?
confidentiality.answer: Every partnership begins with a signed NDA. We do not disclose client identities, earnings, or account data. Discretion is not a policy here — it is the foundation of how we operate.

criteria.question: Who is NHT looking for?
criteria.answer: Creators who treat this as a business, not a side project. We work with emerging talent and established earners. Each application is reviewed individually — we accept fewer than we decline.
